label: uses port
type: the TCP port on which the subject API or service listens. Range: a port: concept.
note: Promoted below the 2-file bar on significance, like sdk:transaction-query-mode in round 4. The registry had no vocabulary for network exposure at all after nine rounds - a striking gap for a database product, and one that only surfaced when extraction finally reached a REST API intro page. Six occurrences on one page, and one of them is the reason to keep it: the cluster-level Query settings API is served on 8091/18091, the Cluster Manager's ports, not on a Query service port - so 'which port do I call for Query?' has no single answer. Mints the port: namespace.
